We've Heard it All. How long does a typical GenStone project take? Most GenStone projects can be completed in a single afternoon or weekend depending on the size of the space. Because the panels are lightweight and designed to interlock, homeowners can install them much faster than traditional masonry stone. Courtney Mintz Project Coordinator Can GenStone be installed indoors and outdoors? Yes. GenStone panels are designed for both interior and exterior applications. They are commonly used for accent walls, fireplace surrounds, entryways, garages, outdoor kitchens, and exterior facades. Evan Trevenna Senior Project Coordinator Do I need special tools to install GenStone panels? No special masonry tools are required. Most projects can be completed using common tools like a circular saw, screws, a drill, and a level. The panels are easy to cut and install using standard woodworking tools. Kevin O'Dwyer General Manager Can I install GenStone panels myself? Yes. GenStone panels are specifically designed for DIY installation. Many homeowners complete projects like accent walls, fireplaces, and garage facades without hiring a contractor.
